messages:
Evan Lewis: hey all, quick ask from day0. I'm trying to map who to bug for different things: deploy pipeline incidents, model-pin approvals, and urgent infra escalations. who owns each lane?
Maya Ortiz: welcome Evan! people-ops doesn't own those but we keep the org chart handy. at a high level: eng-releases owns deploy pipeline, eng-platform owns infra & escalations, and model governance lives with product+research.
Evan Lewis: does eng-platform also handle paging/rotation for infra? like who gets the page when cluster OOMs?
Rajiv Patel: yep, eng-platform owns the infra escalation ladder. primary pager is infra-oncall@pagerduty, with eng-platform lead as first responder and eng-sre as secondary.
Evan Lewis: thanks. for deploy failures (e.g., CI -> prod rollback), who should I CC?
Hannah Lee: deploys are eng-releases. CC releases@redwood and the svc-owner for the service. if it's a rollout rollback, we also notify product-ops for customer-impact triage.
Evan Lewis: good to know. and model-pin approvals — is that a PR in the model-catalog repo or a formal review?
Hannah Lee: model pins require a catalog PR plus an approver from research or product. see the model-governance.md in the repo. you can tag @research-review in the PR.
Evan Lewis: do we have a quick escalation ladder doc I can bookmark? not sure who to call nights/weekends.
Rajiv Patel: sending DM with a short ladder. OpsBot: automation: public escalation summary: 1) infra-oncall (primary) 2) eng-platform lead 3) eng-sre pager 4) director oncall. For deploys: releases@, then service owner, then eng-sre.
Evan Lewis: perfect. last one: if I need emergency access (ssh jumps, DB read) during an incident, who approves fast access?
Maya Ortiz: temporary emergency access is approved by oncall lead + people-ops for audit. file an "Emergency Access" ticket and mark it P0 with a timebox.
Evan Lewis: noted. I'll file a ticket if needed. thanks y'all — this helps me know exactly who to ping.
Rajiv Patel: pro tip: add the following to your bookmarks: /oncall/escalation-ladder, /releases/handbook, /model-governance. they have the contact matrices.
Evan Lewis: bookmarking now. I'll reach out if anything pops up. thanks for the quick orientation! :wave:
